bill.summary:
Joe Fiandra Access to Home Infusion Act of 2025
This bill provides for Medicare coverage of certain home infusion drugs that are administered by health care professionals at a beneficiary’s home.
Specifically, the bill provides for coverage of external infusion pumps and associated home infusion drugs for which (1) the prescription requires that the drug be administered by or under the supervision of a health care professional, (2) a qualified home infusion therapy supplier administers or supervises the administration of the drug at the beneficiary's home, and (3) the prescription requires that the drug be infused at least 12 times per year in a manner that requires the use of an external infusion pump.
